outline.unique_angle: Every top-3 result treats 'AI can't debug' as a code/config or microservices problem. None covers a bug that lives in the PLATFORM MODEL SELECTION layer — where the symptom (low transcription accuracy) is identical to a model-quality issue, so the AI cannot distinguish 'your code is wrong' from 'the platform handed you a different model'. The concrete 60%/92% Web Speech API macOS-vs-iOS story is the wedge: it teaches readers to recognise bugs that are undescribable to an AI because the cause is unobservable from the code itself.
